title: UserStatusChanged
description: The `payload` object of the `user.status.changed` event (MA-139 section 8). Producer: milkful.user (MA-139), via User Service's own adapters/outbox_event_publisher.py — note that publisher wraps this shape one level deeper, under a `payload` key inside the full envelope ({eventId, eventType, eventVersion, source, timestamp, correlationId, payload}), unlike the flat shared/adapters/outbox_event_publisher.py shape most of PaymentConfirmed/OrderConfirmed's own sibling schemas in this directory describe. Consumer: Subscription Service's user_status_changed_consumer.py (MA-140), which unwraps that envelope before validating against this schema.
